changes: Restore stock FLEX playback and SETUP defaults in both working Part copies before removing the Analog BD marker, preventing invalid borrowed parameters from rejecting the retained bank after a machine switch.
Cover both SRC SETUP commit paths and the main machine chooser; preserve existing Analog BD patches on reselection and leave unsigned tracks and other Parts untouched.
808/909 DSP code is byte-identical to 0.1.4. Existing SRC locks, scene targets and LFO destinations remain assigned to their parameter slots and may require adjustment when changing machines.
Private candidate only. Physical reboot/persistence and the reported Output Matrix sequencer halt remain unverified; no earlier release waiver is extended to this source.
